user_requirement: No stage-count ceiling; preserve important scenarios through Demon World Spring.
scope_end: Episode 51 conclusion: Demon King Selection settlement and Demon World Spring acquisition
notes: Working titles and segmentation are newly authored game design, not official novel scenario names.
All nodes preserve the main story route; event-only scenes may be packaged with adjacent playable stages.
Source chapters, scenario numbers, stage IDs and research group IDs are separate namespaces.
No combat values, recipes or narrative alternative victories are finalized.
Primary source and edition verification items remain in the research document.

scenario_coverage.note: 연재본에 없는 명칭이라는 자료의 주석을 유지한다.
정해지지 않은 전용 보스·보상을 만들지 않는다.
자료에서 생략된 번호별 임무·루그라티아의 정확한 번호는 확정하지 않는다.
독립된 규칙을 확인하지 못했으므로 새 퀘스트로 지어내지 않는다.
